p: clap your hands: Here is figured Christ to whom all his should give willing obedience, and who would show himself terrible to the wicked.
subdue the people under us: He has made the Jews who were the keepers of the law and prophets, schoolmasters to the Gentiles, that they would with gladness obey them.
our inheritance for us: God has chosen us above all other nations, to enjoy a most glorious inheritance.
sound of a trumpet: He alludes to the trumpets that were blown at solemn feasts: but he further signifies the triumph of Christ and his glorious ascension into the heavens.
understanding: He requires that understanding be joined with singing, lest the Name of God be profaned with vain crying.
is greatly exalted: He praises God's highness, for that he joins the great princes of the world (whom he calls shields) to the fellowship of his Church.
